TestCase_Description: Verify GPIO level-sensitive interrupt with active-high level selection for all GPIOs 8-39
Pre_Conditions: GIC IRQ 87 enabled; sysreg intr_en1 gpio0_intr enabled
Test_Steps: 1. For each GPIO i (0-31): Write 0x00180000 to gp0_gpio_8+(i*4) to set input mode and level_sel=1; 2. Enable group interrupt bit in gp0_intr1_intr_en1; 3. Drive GPIO pin high; 4. Wait for interrupt; 5. Verify intr_raw_sts=1; 6. Verify group interrupt status; 7. Clear interrupt by writing intr_clr; 8. Verify cleared

Pass_Criteria: Interrupt fires on active-high level; raw status set; group status set; clear successful
Notes: Tests level_sel=1 (high level) interrupt for all 32 GPIO pins sequentially
